sourceEvidence.title: PS&L Automation Manager
sourceEvidence.quote: In this role, you will be supporting the engineering services team within Parts Supply & Logistics (PS&L) within Ford's Customer Service Division (FCSD). Whoever is selected for this position will be at the forefront of Ford operational innovation, working on advanced technology solutions intended to drive enhanced safety, quality, and efficiency for our distribution and packaging business. Key aspects of the position include developing network automation strategy, building out and presenting executive level financial business cases, performing vendor/technology evaluation, hands on implementation of selected solutions, and post implementation support of those solutions in collaboration with other key PS&L departments.
